syllabus.verification: Transcribed against the uploaded official Notification No. 04/OG/HM/2026. This is the complete 15-point Paper I list and 16-point CSE/IT Paper II list.

paper1.title: Current affairs – Regional, National and International
General Science; India’s Achievements in Science and Technology
Environmental issues; Disaster Management – Prevention and Mitigation Strategies
Economic and Social Development of India and Telangana
Physical, Social and Economic Geography of India
Physical, Social and Economic Geography and Demography of Telangana
Socio-economic, Political and Cultural History of Modern India with special emphasis on Indian National Movement
Socio-economic, Political and Cultural History of Telangana with special emphasis on Telangana Statehood Movement and formation of Telangana state
Indian Constitution; Indian Political System; Governance and Public Policy
Social Exclusion; Rights issues such as Gender, Caste, Tribe, Disability etc. and inclusive policies
Society, Culture, Heritage, Arts and Literature of Telangana
Logical Reasoning; Analytical Ability and Data Interpretation

paper2.title: Probability and Statistics
paper2.details: Probability; conditional probability; probability density function; mean, median, mode and standard deviation; random variables; uniform, normal, exponential, Poisson and Binomial distributions.

paper2.title: Set Theory & Algebra; Linear Algebra
paper2.details: Sets; relations; functions; groups; partial orders; lattice; Boolean algebra; algebra of matrices; determinants; systems of linear equations; eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

paper2.title: Combinatorics and Discrete Structures; Graph Theory; Mathematical Logic
paper2.details: Permutations; combinations; counting; summation; generating functions; recurrence relations; connectivity; spanning trees; cut vertices and edges; covering; matching; independent sets; coloring; planarity; isomorphism; propositional logic; first-order logic.

paper2.title: Digital Logic
paper2.details: Logic functions; minimization; design and synthesis of combinational and sequential circuits; number representation and computer arithmetic (fixed and floating point).

paper2.title: Computer Organization and Architecture
paper2.details: Machine instructions and addressing modes; ALU; CPU control design; memory interface; I/O interface (interrupt and DMA mode); instruction pipelining; cache and main memory; secondary storage; multiprocessors.

paper2.title: Programming and Data Structures
paper2.details: Programming in C; functions; recursion; parameter passing; scope; binding; abstract data types; arrays; stacks; queues; linked lists; trees; binary search trees; binary heaps.

paper2.title: Algorithms
paper2.details: Analysis; asymptotic notation; space and time complexity; worst and average case analysis; greedy approach; dynamic programming; divide-and-conquer; tree and graph traversals; connected components; spanning trees; shortest paths; hashing; sorting; searching; best, worst and average case time/space; upper and lower bounds; P, NP, NP-hard and NP-complete.

paper2.title: Theory of Computation
paper2.details: Regular languages and finite automata; context-free languages and push-down automata; recursively enumerable sets and Turing machines; undecidability.

paper2.title: Compiler Design
paper2.details: Lexical analysis; parsing; syntax-directed translation; runtime environments; intermediate and target code generation; basics of code optimization.

paper2.title: Operating Systems
paper2.details: Processes; threads; inter-process communication; concurrency; synchronization; deadlock; CPU scheduling; memory management and virtual memory; file systems; I/O systems; protection and security; system calls; disk scheduling.

paper2.title: Databases
paper2.details: ER model; relational model (relational algebra, tuple relational calculus); database design (integrity constraints, normal forms); SQL; file structures (sequential files, indexing, B and B+ trees); transactions and concurrency control.

paper2.title: Information Systems and Software Engineering
paper2.details: Information gathering; requirement and feasibility analysis; data flow diagrams; process specifications; input/output design; process life cycle; project planning and management; design; coding; testing; implementation; maintenance; introduction to UML.

paper2.title: Computer Networks
paper2.details: ISO/OSI reference model; LAN technologies (Ethernet, Token ring); flow and error control; routing algorithms; congestion control; TCP/UDP and sockets; IPv4; ICMP, DNS, SMTP, POP, FTP, HTTP; hubs, switches, gateways and routers; public/private key cryptography; digital signature; firewalls.

paper2.title: Web Technologies
paper2.details: Introduction to PHP; XML; Servlets; JSP; client-side scripting.

paper2.title: OOPS Concepts, Programming in C++ and JAVA
paper2.details: Object-oriented programming concepts; programming in C++ and Java.

paper2.title: Data Mining
paper2.details: Introduction to data mining; association rules; classification algorithms; clustering algorithms.

questionBankPolicy.examAlignment: Questions must map to the exact subtopics in uploaded HMWSSB Notification 04/OG/HM/2026.
styleRequirements: Degree-level recruitment-exam standard; not school-level recall or one-line definitions.

Prefer application, code/output tracing, numerical problems, scenario analysis, multi-step reasoning, SQL/query evaluation, graph and algorithm analysis, and close concept discrimination where appropriate.
All four options must be plausible, distinct and based on common misconceptions.
No ambiguous wording, hidden assumptions or multiple defensible answers.
Use short code, tables, data, constraints or scenarios where they improve exam authenticity.
Paper I must match the official notification scope and competitive-exam depth.

nonRepetition.rule: Every question receives a permanent unique questionId and normalized text fingerprint.
nonRepetition.selection: Never serve an attempted question in normal practice. Reuse only in explicitly labelled revision/error-review mode.
nonRepetition.tracking: Store questionId, topicId, difficulty, source basis, attempt date, selected option, correct option, explanation and outcome.
nonRepetition.deduplication: Check exact IDs and normalized wording before publishing; manually inspect near-duplicates.

questionBankPolicy.answerReview: After submission, explain the correct answer and why each of the other three options is wrong.
questionBankPolicy.qualityControl: Independently validate answer keys and calculations. Exclude uncertain questions.

questionBankPolicy.runtime: The website records attempted question IDs locally and excludes them from normal practice.
